claim: H9/14 survivor record 37 cannot be the nerve of a compact hyperbolic Coxeter 9-polytope.
nonclaims: This excludes one graph shadow, not all compact H9/14 nerves.
The archived bounded Z3 timeout contributes no logical step.
No Coxeter labels or Lorentzian Gram matrices are classified.
This is not a general non-existence theorem in dimension 9.
proof_backend: exact local g-vectors, five-row isolate-column compression, blocker duality, and complete ridge replay; no SAT/SMT
proof_dependencies: Burcroff's no-missing-triples theorem for compact H9/14 nerves
every compact Coxeter missing face is Lanner of order at most five
strict generalized lower-bound and local Macaulay inequalities
maximal faces are complementary to inclusion-minimal transversals of the complete minimal-nonface clutter
every ridge of a simplicial polytope boundary has degree two
